_readme: Content for 'Meet the millets'. Facts are agronomic/cultural only (no health claims). Client to re-verify before launch.

millets.name: Foxtail
millets.fact: One of the oldest farmed grains on earth, cultivated for roughly 8,000 years.

millets.name: Jowar
millets.fact: The world's fifth most-grown cereal, and the grain behind Maharashtra's bhakri.

millets.name: Little Millet
millets.fact: Domesticated in India. In Tamil kitchens it's samai, cooked like rice.

millets.name: Kodo
millets.fact: Domesticated in India around 3,000 years ago. Grows where most crops give up.

millets.name: Barnyard
millets.fact: The vrat grain. Samvat ke chawal on fasting days? That's barnyard.

millets.name: Ragi
millets.fact: Karnataka grows more ragi than any other Indian state.
